CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nfl_roster.can_issue(pid text, fantasy_position text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(fantasy_position in('QB','RB','WR','TE') and (
 not exists(select 1 from nfl_roster.control where enabled)
 or exists(select 1 from nfl_roster.current_evidence r where r.player_id=pid and r.identity_verified
 and r.status='active' and r.checked_at<=statement_timestamp() and r.checked_at>statement_timestamp()-interval '72 hours'
 and (fantasy_position=any(string_to_array(r.position,'/')) or (fantasy_position='RB' and r.position in('FB','HB'))))),false)
$function$

weeklyFunctions.signature: season_catalogue.can_issue(s text, y text, p uuid, kind text)
weeklyFunctions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION season_catalogue.can_issue(s text, y text, p uuid, kind text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from season_catalogue.members m join season_catalogue.rights r on r.id=m.rights_id
 where m.sport=s and m.season=y and m.player_id=p and m.scope=kind
 and r.valid_from<=statement_timestamp() and (r.valid_until is null or r.valid_until>statement_timestamp())
 and not coalesce((select d.blocked from season_catalogue.decisions d where d.rights_id=r.id and d.player_id is null order by d.id desc limit 1),false)
 and not coalesce((select d.blocked from season_catalogue.decisions d where d.rights_id=r.id and d.player_id=p order by d.id desc limit 1),false))
$function$

weeklyFunctions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sports_feed.weekly_core_allowed(u uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from sports_feed.weekly_core_control where enabled)
 and exists(select 1 from sports_feed.nfl_control where enabled)
 and beta_private.admitted(u)
 and exists(select 1 from credits_sandbox.access where user_id=u and enabled)
 and not exists(select 1 from beta_fantasy.members where user_id=u and (revoked_at is not null or expires_at<=clock_timestamp()))
 and exists(select 1 from beta_public.profiles where id=u and disabled_at is null)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sports_feed.weekly_core_allowed(u uuid, s text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case when s='nfl' then sports_feed.weekly_core_allowed(u) else
 s in ('afl','nrl') and exists(select 1 from sports_feed.weekly_sport_programmes where sport=s and enabled)
 and beta_private.admitted(u)
 and exists(select 1 from credits_sandbox.access where user_id=u and enabled)
 and exists(select 1 from sports_feed.sport_sandbox_access where user_id=u)
 and exists(select 1 from sports_feed.private_beta_sports where sport=s and enabled)
 and exists(select 1 from sports_feed.nba_beta_control where enabled)
 and exists(select 1 from sports_feed.nba_beta_access where user_id=u and enabled and expires_at>clock_timestamp())
 and exists(select 1 from beta_public.profiles where id=u and disabled_at is null)
 and not exists(select 1 from beta_fantasy.members where user_id=u and (revoked_at is not null or expires_at<=clock_timestamp())) end
$function$
